The game executable. A custom renamed engine is allowed. Its filename is added to the focus allow-list.
The game data/mod folder. Defaults to main for Kingpin.exe and baseq2 for other executables. Choose another folder for a mod or renamed Kingpin engine.
A UTF-8 file of wrong phrase=correct phrase entries. Phrase matching is case-insensitive.
Where speech models are cached. Relative paths are relative to this JoyVox folder. Leave blank for the backend default cache.
Hold to record; release to transcribe. Examples: mouse4, mouse5, a letter, or an F-key.
Selects public chat for the next recording. May be blank to disable this shortcut.
Selects team chat for the next recording. May be blank to disable this shortcut.
Manually sends prepared text to public chat. Also used for automatic public delivery.
Manually sends prepared text to team chat. Also used for automatic team delivery.
A plain .cfg filename, without folders, inside the game / mod output folder.
Game bindings .cfg filename. Install / repair adds exec followed by this filename to autoexec.cfg without overwriting other commands.
auto uses the Windows default. The GUI lists microphone names even before setup. name: selects a named input; numeric indices choose a specific PortAudio device.
auto selects large-v3-turbo on NVIDIA and small.en on CPU. A supported model name or converted model directory is also accepted.
The model used when automatic recognition selects the CPU.
auto tries NVIDIA CUDA and falls back to CPU with an explanation. cuda requires NVIDIA support; cpu forces CPU inference.
auto uses a supported default. int8_float16 can reduce NVIDIA memory use; int8 is suitable for CPU.
Whisper language code. en is English and avoids automatic language guessing for short clips.
Integer from 1 to 10. Higher search widths may improve accuracy but require more processing.
Push forward and cover me. Watch the stairs. I need health, armor, and ammo. Nice shot, good game. Quake II, Kingpin, deathmatch, capture the flag, Bagman, cash bag, safe, rocket launcher, railgun.
Example wording and game vocabulary, not instructions to the model. Add actual player names and terms you use; keep it concise.
Kingpin, Bagman, cash bag, safe, team
Comma-separated player names and game terms. Dictionary corrections also supply vocabulary hints.
Use speech activity detection to reduce guesses from silence and non-speech audio.
Ignore shorter presses. Does not count pre-roll or release padding. Range: 0 to 3 seconds.
Integer from 1 to 64. More threads are not always faster, particularly while a game is running.
Warm CPU recognition before READY. NVIDIA always performs an inference check before READY.
Optional semicolon-separated CUDA/cuDNN runtime folders. Usually leave blank when using this launcher's installer.
A small RAM-only buffer protects the first consonant. 0 to 1000 ms. Idle microphone audio is never saved.
Protect the final consonant by collecting a short tail. 0 to 1000 ms.
Stop a long hold automatically. Release the button before recording again. Range: 1 to 120 seconds.
Maximum recordings waiting behind the one being recognized. Range: 1 to 10.
Capitalize the first letter of the prepared message.
Keep proper-name capitalization. When disabled, mixed-case words are lowercased; acronyms remain.
Append punctuation when needed. When disabled, a single trailing period is removed.
Keep exclamation marks. When disabled, they become sentence breaks.
Transliterate Latin accents and use ASCII for the original Kingpin font.
Press the selected game chat key after recognition. Disable to send manually with the public/team keys.
Reset both output aliases after a send, preventing accidental repeats.
Delay before clearing sent output. Range: 0.2 to 10 seconds. Newer output is protected from older clears.
Only auto-send to the focused game
Check the foreground executable before simulating a send key. Prepared text remains available if the game is not focused.
Comma-separated executable filenames allowed for automatic delivery. The selected game executable is included automatically.
Master switch for JoyVox's microphone and recognition sounds.
Play feedback when push-to-talk begins and finishes.
Play feedback when speech is recognized. Sounds are suppressed during capture.
Play feedback for empty speech or recognition errors. Sounds are suppressed during capture.
Opt-in: save only the most recent PTT recording and result to help diagnose recognition errors. Idle audio is never saved.
Destination for the latest optional diagnostic clip and result; files are overwritten each utterance.
